says: In next/, the L17/L18 rebuild law's three fast runs on seed 119120 never reach the compiler move, so its reach check fails at the default depth (expected the set fit, syntax, compiler; got syntax, fit). It fails the same with main's product files. Fixed in this pull request: the law's input is now a record with the move drawn from fit, syntax and compiler, and one save of each move runs as an example before the random runs, so every depth reaches all three.
proof: Run alone at 49b01c72f and with origin/main's product files swapped in, the same assertion fails both times. After the fix, the law passes alone at the default depth (6.7 s) and at FABRIKA_TEST_DEPTH=full (51 s).
cost: The law is red at the default depth while the rebuilds it protects may be fine.
